---
title: "Load Normative Networks"
description: "Load and visualize normative brain networks from the TVBO database."
---

# Get Normative Networks

```{python}
from tvbo import Network

Network.from_db(rec="avgMatrix", atlas="DesikanKilliany").plot_overview(
    plot_brain=True, log_weights=True
)
```


```python
sc = Network.from_db(
    tpl="FSLMNI152",
    cohort="HCPYA",
    rec="dTOR",
    atlas="Schaefer2018",
    seg="7Networks",
    scale=1000,
    desc="SC",
)
sc.plot_overview(plot_brain=True, log_weights=True)
```
